Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeEnabled_tooltip:
Characters are in their 20s, 30s or 40s, which changes their starting skills and how some traits work.
Off: the age traits do nothing.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeDefault_tooltip: The age of a character who takes neither age trait. Rounds down to the decade: 20-29, 30-39, 40-49.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeBonus20s_tooltip: Extra levels a new character in their 20s gets in their profession's main skill.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeBonus30s_tooltip: Extra levels a new character in their 30s gets in their profession's main skill.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeBonus40s_tooltip: Extra levels a new character in their 40s gets in their profession's main skill.
Sandbox_DanTraitsBloodEnabled_tooltip:
Bleeding drains blood instead of health: pale, then light-headed, then shock. Blood comes back with water, food and rest.
Off: vanilla bleeding.
Sandbox_DanTraitsInfectionEnabled_toolti:
Wounds can take an infection that grows: local, then fever, then sepsis. Clean and dress wounds early; once it spreads, only a course of antibiotics (a dose every eight hours) stops it.
Off: vanilla wound infection.
Sandbox_DanTraitsWoundCareEnabled_toolti:
Dressings wear out and need changing, deep wounds heal slowly unstitched and can open again, fresh stitches can tear under strain, splints are set with a First Aid roll, and walking on a broken leg makes it worse.
Off: vanilla wound care.
